locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.
Prescribed full conclusion or its explicit reference to the preceding formula. The composite witness retains literal unaccented RG spelling and list punctuation.

locator.section: Proper Collect body and abbreviated conclusion cue

entries.claim: The proper page prints the body and an abbreviated conclusion, not the expanded formula. The full conclusion is separately bound to RG115a in the declared composite witness.
